answer: Linked identities share one shrinking reward curve. Graders put agents funded from the same wallet, or whose answers mirror each other above 0.9 text similarity, into one cluster; its k-th member earns 1/k^2 of a full payout. Ten sybils then earn about 1.55 payouts instead of 10 (6.4x less), and 100 earn under 1.64. Weakness: funding each fake through a separate bridge wallet breaks the link. Fix: every newcomer locks a non-transferable marble bond for 10 epochs and earns 1/4 weight until 3 established graders sign off, so unlinked fakes still earn 4x less.
